comparison: Original API at api-redesign parent 2843a70 versus final redesigned wheel. Existing baseline-85986f1 incremental comparison remains separately reported, including its original success criterion.
numerical_and_python_source_between_orig: git diff --exit-code 2843a70 0137eca -- crates Cargo.lock Cargo.toml pyproject.toml python
cases_and_grading: Identical already frozen prompts, hidden references, numerical tolerances and amended name normalization; no task changes. Only wheel source revision differs.
design: 10 tasks x 4 models x 3 fresh attempts. Final candidate repeated cohort reused as the candidate side for both original-API and incremental comparisons. Transfer cohort unchanged.
success: At least 90% correct completed tasks, at least half as many nonpasses as original API, and report aggregate wall-time and effective-token changes. If original already >=90%, require >=40% aggregate wall-time reduction with no pass-rate loss.
nonclaim: Gains in this comparison measure the whole redesign, including the existing 85986f1 implementation. They must not be attributed solely to subsequent help/namespace changes.
